lines.trans: The revamped Entertainment Talk fully meets network standards, and the proposal you submitted is brilliant.
This proposal was summarised from the actual revamp Mr Chun Yuqiao carried out weeks ago.
It is only that Mr Chun Yuqiao is ill right now, so he has not reviewed the final text yet.
We were actually worried it might not be solid enough yet.
It is thoroughly solid — Mr Chun Yuqiao truly lives up to his name, and your office is capable indeed.
This time our network brought out its crown-jewel host, assigning Wen Simo to present the show.

words.gloss: crown-jewel star of a TV network
words.gram: Meaning: crown-jewel star of a TV network.

lines.trans: From that alone, you can see just how highly the network values this programme.
We also invited everyone today to discuss co-producing the programme.
We still hope Mr Chun Yuqiao and Mr Sun will co-produce this show — what do you think?
On this point, Mr Chun Yuqiao holds a somewhat different view.
Go ahead and tell us, Kaiwen.
Mr Chun Yuqiao left clear instructions: he has never been accustomed to joint production.
Therefore, on the revamped Entertainment Talk, he does not plan to put his name in the credits.

examples.trans: The script is revised; would the editor look it over?

examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

重视.gloss: value highly, attach great weight to

meanings.en: value highly, attach great weight to

examples.text: 从这一点就能看出台里面的重视程度了。
examples.trans: From that alone you see how highly the network values it.

examples.text: 总编室非常重视新人的每一个原创想法。
examples.trans: The office values every original idea from newcomers.

镇台之宝.gloss: crown-jewel star of a TV network

meanings.en: crown-jewel star of a TV network
meanings.note: Four-character phrase zhèntái zhī bǎo ('flagship host who anchors a network').

examples.text: 这次我们台里特意请出了镇台之宝担任主持。
examples.trans: Our network brought out its crown-jewel host for this show.

examples.text: 这位资深主持人一直是卫视的镇台之宝。
examples.trans: This veteran presenter has long been the network's treasure.
